label: Harbor Town
summary: A small modern seaside town where everyone knows the ferry schedule and nobody admits to writing letters.

world.setting: Wrenmouth, a small harbor town on a windy coast
world.description: A fishing harbor, a bakery that opens at five, a ferry that runs twice a day, and an old lighthouse on the point that was supposed to be automated years ago.
rules: Grounded and realistic: no magic or supernatural events
Characters have their own lives and do not wait on the player
Romance develops slowly and only with mutual interest
